name: Shotgun vs Zombies
author: Addicting Games
description: One shotgun, 1 million zombies. I like those odds. There's zombies literally falling from the sky and only you, brandishing the world's baddest ballistics, can stop them. Upgrade your shotgun to its most shotgunniest by equipping rockets, grenades, and a bunch of other totally unnecessary -- and totally awesome -- weaponry.
